name: SaaS Help Center Demo Suite
description: Golden tests for common SaaS support questions where facts are spread across short help-center snippets.

cases.question: What is the refund window and condition?

documents.title: Refund Window
documents.content: Customers can request a refund within 30 days of purchase.

documents.title: Refund Condition
documents.content: Refund approval requires that the item is unused and returned with its receipt.

documents.title: Refund Exclusions
documents.content: Custom enterprise onboarding fees are not eligible for refunds.

cases.question: How can a user reset a forgotten password?
expectedFacts: Use the Forgot password link on the sign in page
A reset link is sent by email

documents.title: Forgotten Password
documents.content: Users who forget a password should select the Forgot password link on the sign in page.

documents.title: Password Email
documents.content: The system sends a password reset link to the verified email address on the account.

documents.title: Reset Link Expiry
documents.content: Password reset links expire after 60 minutes for security.

cases.question: What happens when an account is deleted?
expectedFacts: Account deletion starts from the workspace settings page
Data is permanently removed after 14 days

documents.title: Delete Account
documents.content: Workspace owners can start account deletion from the workspace settings page.

documents.title: Deletion Retention
documents.content: Deleted account data is permanently removed after a 14 day recovery period.

documents.title: Deletion Billing
documents.content: Deleting a workspace cancels future billing after the current invoice cycle closes.

cases.question: Who can upgrade a subscription and when does the change apply?
expectedFacts: Only workspace admins can upgrade a subscription

documents.title: Upgrade Permission
documents.content: Only workspace admins can upgrade or downgrade a subscription plan.

documents.title: Upgrade Timing
documents.content: Plan upgrades take effect immediately and unlock new limits in the same session.

documents.title: Upgrade Billing
documents.content: The next invoice includes prorated charges for the upgraded plan.

cases.question: How does a customer export workspace data?
expectedFacts: Admins can request a data export from workspace settings
The export is delivered as a downloadable archive

documents.title: Data Export Request
documents.content: Workspace admins can request a data export from workspace settings.

documents.title: Export Delivery
documents.content: When processing finishes, the export is delivered as a downloadable archive.

documents.title: Export Format
documents.content: Exports include CSV files for tables and JSON files for audit events.

cases.question: What should I know about inviting teammates?
expectedFacts: Admins and managers can invite teammates

documents.title: Invite Roles
documents.content: Admins and managers can invite teammates from the Members screen.

documents.title: Invite Expiry
documents.content: Pending team invitations expire after 7 days if they are not accepted.

documents.title: Resend Invites
documents.content: Expired invitations can be resent by an admin.

cases.question: Where can billing invoices be downloaded?
expectedFacts: Invoices are available in the billing history page
Only billing admins can download invoices

documents.title: Invoice Location
documents.content: Invoices are available in the billing history page for each workspace.

documents.title: Invoice Permission
documents.content: Only billing admins can download invoice PDFs.

documents.title: Invoice Email
documents.content: Billing contacts also receive invoice notification emails.

cases.question: What security controls protect customer accounts?
expectedFacts: Single sign on is available on enterprise plans
Two factor authentication can be required

documents.title: Single Sign On
documents.content: Single sign on is available on enterprise plans for centralized identity management.

documents.title: Audit Logs
documents.content: Audit logs record administrative changes such as role updates and billing changes.

documents.title: Two Factor Authentication
documents.content: Workspace owners can require two factor authentication for all members.
